exact: coding-region determinant of instability-mediated mRNA stability complex
coding-region instability determinant -mediated mRNA stability complex

definition: A protein complex that binds to, and promotes stabilization of, mRNA molecules containing the coding region instability determinant (CRD). In human, it may consist of IGF2BP1, HNRNPU, SYNCRIP/HNRNPQ, YBX1, and DHX9.
label: CRD-mediated mRNA stability complex
